title: Regime-Conditioned Evaluation in Multi-Context Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2605.04895v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Published transfer-BO comparisons often estimate an average treatment effect of acquisition choice over hidden regime variables, while practitioners need the conditional effect for their specific prior quality, budget ratio, and metric. An audit of 40 transfer-BO papers from NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AISTATS, UAI, TMLR, JMLR, and AutoML-Conf (2022-2025) finds that 98% never vary B/|A| as a controlled axis. On the same GDSC2 benchmark, changing only the budget reverses the ranking: at B=50, Greedy outperforms UCB by 0.050 Hit@1, while at B=100, UCB outperforms Greedy by 0.035. We capture this transition with the Portable Regime Score PRS=(B/|A|)(1-rho), where rho is the prior rank correlation and can be estimated from pilot contexts before the main comparison. translated_title: 多上下文贝叶斯优化中的状态条件化评估
translated_abstract: 已发表的迁移贝叶斯优化（transfer-BO）比较研究通常在隐藏的状态变量上估计采集函数选择的平均处理效应，而实际应用者需要的是针对其特定先验质量、预算比例和度量指标的条件效应。对来自 NeurIPS、ICML、ICLR、AISTATS、UAI、TMLR、JMLR 和 AutoML-Conf（2022-2025）的 40 篇迁移贝叶斯优化论文的审查发现，98% 的论文从未将 B/|A| 作为受控变量轴进行变化。在相同的 GDSC2 基准上，仅改变预算就会逆转排名：当 B=50 时，Greedy 在 Hit@1 上比 UCB 高 0.050；而当 B=100 时，UCB 比 Greedy 高 0.035。我们用可移植状态得分（Portable Regime Score）PRS=(B/|A|)(1-ρ) 来刻画这一转变，其中 ρ 是先验秩相关系数，可以在主比较之前从试点上下文中估计得到。在涵盖化学、药物反应生物学和超参数优化（HPO）的 79 个条件中，层次模型给出 β=0.50（p=1.1e-9），且 19% 的条件落入等效区，其中 |adv……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了迁移贝叶斯优化中采集函数的排名会随预算比例和先验质量等状态变量而逆转（98% 的已发表比较从未控制这一变量），并提出可用先验信息估计的可移植状态得分 PRS=(B/|A|)(1-ρ) 来预测这种排名转变，从而主张以状态条件化评估取代平均效应比较。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that acquisition function rankings in transfer Bayesian optimization reverse across budget regimes (uncontrolled in 98% of published comparisons) and proposes the Portable Regime Score PRS=(B/|A|)(1-ρ), estimable from pilot contexts, to predict these reversals and advocate regime-conditioned evaluation over average-effect comparisons.
